diagnosis: The customer is asking for the procedure to reset an API token. Since they use unified_auth, they must use the scoped key rotation process.
reply: Based on your account configuration, you manage credentials as scoped keys. To rotate your API token, please create a replacement key, migrate your traffic to the new key, and then revoke the previous one. Please note that revocation is immediate and there is no grace period. You can find more details in our documentation on scoped API keys.
